# Agent Note: Right-panel and terminal work loops

Status: implemented

English | [中文](2026-08-16-surfaces-terminal-work-loops.zh.md)

## Problem

The desktop surfaces column and conversation terminal drawer shipped a five-card shell and PTY split, then stopped at thin viewers. Files could not search or save. Browser was a naked URL box. Diff's empty card lit up for any cwd and reused server-session copy. Terminal selection could not enter the composer. Empty-state cards are not a finished column.

## Decision

Keep the dsh slot/store composition and `--dsw-alias-*` chrome. Implement the work loops this desktop can own:

- Files: name search (uncapped DFS under the workspace root; the tree walks once per search session and further keystrokes filter the cached results in memory; `listDir` batch-classifies ignores through one `git check-ignore --stdin -z` per directory), utf8 edit/save through `shell:write-file` (workspace-authority, 1 MiB read/write cap). Refresh reloads the root listing; while a search is active it re-walks that search so nested matches are not dropped. Mention is a row control into the composer (markdown file link) and is omitted without a session id; file-tree rows drag into the composer as the same markdown link (`application/x-dshd-composer-mention`). Composer `@` is official ui-reference; skills are official `/` via ui-skill. The context menu copies relative or absolute path, reveals in the folder, opens in a probed editor, or opens with the system default. A failed write keeps the editor and the unsaved buffer. Closing a dirty `surfaces.file` tab confirms (Keep / Discard / Save); `FilePreview` reports dirty via `onDirtyChange` even when cwd is briefly missing, hydrates from `readBuffer` before paint, and does not show the editor until the first read settles. Occupant React keys and dirty callbacks are session-scoped so two sessions with the same path keep separate drafts. In-memory buffers survive session switches until the tab closes; a dirty draft is kept when disk bytes change under it, and a failed reread does not wipe it. Save (toolbar, Ctrl/Cmd+S, and close-dialog) writes while the tab is active, cwd exists, and the draft is dirty, including when the last reread failed or returned truncated or binary bytes. A dirty draft stays in the editor (Markdown Source included) in those cases and when cwd is missing; Save stays disabled until cwd returns. A successful write clears truncated/binary so the editor remains. Dirty drafts persist in the surfaces localStorage bucket across reload and quit (`pagehide` / `beforeunload` flush, canceling a pending debounce so Discard cannot be overwritten). Activating a file tab rereads disk under the draft. Save rereads first and refuses once when disk diverged from both the remembered baseline and the draft (`error.changed`). Explicit Save flushes through the same `FileSaveCoordinator` queue as the 500ms debounce write, so the two never interleave and characters typed during an in-flight save stay dirty. Jump-to-line (`revealLine` / `revealRequestId`) scrolls the source textarea and shows source while that reveal is pending. A non-collapsed source selection shows Add to chat, which appends an `L` range and a `text` fence of those lines to the composer; outside click and Escape dismiss the selection.
- Browser: back / forward / reload / system-browser (URL bar, even before a guest) / discovered loopback ports (rescanned while the occupant is mounted); chrome is icon Back/Forward/Reload, an `Input` that submits on Enter, a system-browser icon, and a More menu (Hard reload, DevTools, Open/Close separate preview window, Show/Hide device toolbar, Pick element, Start/Stop recording, Screenshot, Appearance, zoom, Clear cookies, Clear cache). Address bar `normalizePreviewUrl` treats a bare loopback host as `http` and a bare public host as `https`. Guest documents may be any `http(s)`; the harness main window stays loopback; `file:` documents are cancelled. Guest `did-navigate` / `did-navigate-in-page` emit `shell:preview-state-change` so the URL bar and back/forward follow in-guest navigation. CDN subresources are allowed. Occupancy hide is `overlayOpen || pipOpen` (More, device preset menu, PiP): `active` hides the guest via `previewHide`; `occluded` also hides it while surface menus or the unsaved-file dialog overlap the native hit-test area; closing the tab calls `previewClose`. Device toolbar sizes the BrowserView through `previewResize` / `setBounds`; it does not call CDP `Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride`. Pick inserts markdown into the composer when a session exists. Recording is host-renderer `MediaRecorder`; artifacts land under `userData/preview-recordings/`. Open occupants stay mounted across surface tab switches. Terminal, conversation loopback, and desktop `openPath` of `.html` / `.htm` / `.xhtml` / `.pdf` use `dshd-open-surface` plus `dshd-pending-preview-url` (those documents also keep a Files `file:` tab; the active tab is Browser). SVG remains an image in Files. The FilePreview toolbar "Open in Browser" gate uses the same browser-document extension set. Each client package repeats those two strings; slot rules forbid a shared value export.
- Diff: `gitStatus` empty-card gate; Working tree vs Branch (`gitDiff(cwd, { baseRef })` three-dot range, non-zero exit returns null); a valid repo with a failed diff shows the load error, not the non-repo card. Working-tree hunks are `git diff HEAD` (staged and unstaged on the same file). Porcelain Stage / Unstage / Discard stay on the file list when an op fails (`opError` banner); untracked (`??`) discard runs `git clean -f` (`-fd` for directories). Collapse all / Expand all. The branch Menu searches every listed ref. Branch scope hides Stage / Unstage / Discard. Split view, ignore-whitespace, and word-wrap toggles stay out.
- Terminal: selection Copy / Add to chat (fenced `terminal` draft via `ctx.get('conversation')`; the action is disabled without a session id); ⌘/Ctrl-click and selection Open for http(s) and workspace paths; loopback http(s) opens Browser and other http(s) calls `window.shell.openExternal`; workspace paths split `:line:column` off the filesystem path and pass `{ line }` to `workspaces.openPath` so FilePreview `revealLine` can jump (column is not forwarded); maximize restores the last **conversation drawer** height (the `surfaces.terminal` occupant has no separate maximize). Ctrl/Cmd+` toggles the drawer even while the Ghostty pane has focus: `beforeKey` refuses that combination so it bubbles to the titlebar window listener, and the titlebar keybindings recognize `[data-terminal-pane]` (not `.xterm`) as terminal focus.
- Layout: `dshd.layout.panels` persists last-open surfaces width and terminal-drawer height, including whether they were open.

GPU terminal embedding, worktree environments, checkpoint turn-diff, and review-comment pick stay out: this harness has no equivalent session metadata, and shipping a half-stack would lie. Diff split / wrap / ignore-whitespace stay out. Agents rows use the session-list snapshot (running/inactive, mode, jobs); job lifecycle status uses locale copy; jobs are read-only; there is no token counter or workflow-script tree on that snapshot.

## Alternatives considered

**Ship the five cards and call the column done.** Rejected: the value is the loop (search, save, navigate, select-into-chat), not the card grid.

**Paste Tailwind GPU-terminal occupants.** Rejected: design-language rule 15 and the slot/four-share contract.

**Fake turn-diff from conversation events.** Rejected: no durable checkpoint range exists; a fake Latest turn would be a second downgrade.

**Treat Diff chrome (split / wrap / ignore-whitespace) as required for the work loop.** Rejected: those are rendering toggles; the loop is search, save, navigate, and select-into-chat. Split remains a Diff README limitation.

## Consequences

`workspace-fs.writeFile`, `preview.back/forward/reload/state/openDevTools/discover` plus `shell:preview-state-change` and `shell:preview-workspace-file`, and `gitDiff(..., { baseRef })` are the desktop IPC. Privileged BrowserView / BrowserWindow navigation uses hostname-parsed loopback checks (`local-url.js`) for the harness main window, boot `file:` is pinned to packaged `boot.html`, `showHarness` rejects non-loopback base URLs and rewrites `0.0.0.0`, denied remote http(s) `openExternal`, denied loopback that is not the harness origin is sent as `shell:open-preview-url` on that contents (boot windows omit that option and still `openExternal`), and both `will-navigate` and `will-redirect` are guarded (`will-redirect` deny-only). Guest documents may be any `http(s)`; `file:` stays cancelled. Client packages consume them through existing `window.shell` injects. Terminal selection writes a fenced draft, not a composer chip. File opens from the terminal go through `workspaces.openPath` (desktop intercepts into Files, and HTML/HTM/XHTML/PDF also Browser) with `{ line }` when a `:line` suffix was present. Work loops (search, save, guest URL, Stage/Discard, loopback vs system browser, PiP, pick, recording, revealLine, mention drag) are in this note; conversation dual-open and the token-prefixed workspace listener are in [conversation links into Files and Browser](2026-08-19-conversation-surface-links.md); the port's isolation and chrome rules are in [Files/Browser logic port](2026-08-19-files-browser-logic-port.md). Diff split / wrap / ignore-whitespace stay out.

## Testing

`src/main/local-url.test.js` pins loopback spoof rejection, the absence of `isMarketplaceNavigationUrl`, and navigate/redirect allow policies. `src/main/window-nav.test.js` pins privileged guard wiring (deny + remote http(s) openExternal; cross-port loopback preview on that contents; harness-origin popup neither; `will-redirect` deny-only). `src/main/workspace-fs.test.js` pins write + traversal and the 1 MiB caps. `src/main/preview.test.js` pins history, discover, frame vs subresource filter, guest `did-navigate` `onState`, `shell:preview-workspace-file`, pick, and PiP window isolation. `src/main/preview-session.test.js` pins guest `contextIsolation: false` + `sandbox: true` and leftover UA-token strip. `src/main/preview-workspace.test.js` pins token-prefix 404, traversal, directory 403, POST 405, Host, and close. `src/main/git.test.js` pins `baseRef`, missing-branch null, and untracked `gitDiscard` via `git clean`. `ui-surfaces` pins Diff gated on `gitStatus`, `dshd-open-surface`, html/svg `openPath` dual-open after Files, missing or failed `previewWorkspaceFile` leaving Files without throwing, `onOpenPreviewUrl` forwarding, keep-alive tab switches (Files draft + Browser inactive/menu-occluded→hide / tab-close→close), dirty file-tab close confirm (keep / discard / save, including a failed Save that keeps the tab), file-buffer restore across session switches, separate drafts when two sessions open the same path, and dirty-draft persist across `pagehide` remount (Discard cancels a pending debounce write). `ui-preview` opens a guest through Enter in the URL bar, a discovered chip, and the pending-URL event, and pins toolbar nav, guest URL-bar updates, inactive/occluded/More-menu/PiP hide vs unmount close, device-toolbar `setBounds`, pick markdown, and host MediaRecorder (fake recorder; live Electron MediaRecorder/CDP is not proven). `ui-user-terminal` pins selection Copy / Add to chat / Open, loopback URL → Browser vs other http(s) → `openExternal`, `{ line }` into `openPath`, drawer maximize restore, and no maximize on `surfaces.terminal`. `ui-files` pins uncapped search, file-tree mention drag, revealLine, Add to chat, mention omitted without a session id, save (including a failed write that keeps the editor, a disk-changed save that keeps the draft with `error.changed`, registerSave writing after a failed reread, and a dirty draft that stays editable/saveable after a truncated or binary reread), Markdown source (including after a failed or truncated reread and when cwd is missing), unsaved draft across a hidden keep-alive parent, dirty reporting when cwd is missing, dirty draft kept when disk changes or reread fails, Ctrl+S save only while the tab is active, activate reread that keeps the draft, and no editor until the first read settles. `ui-layout` pins surfaces/drawer persist. `ui-diff` pins the branch-scope three-dot call, load-error vs non-repo, Stage failure keeping the file list, and branch-menu search past fifty refs. `ui-agents-panel` pins job status through the locale table. Hardening additions: `ui-files` pins the serialized save coordinator (explicit flush behind an in-flight debounce write, characters typed during a save staying dirty, one walk per search session with in-memory keystroke filtering, an independent copy status marker, and no `<img>` for a truncated image); `ui-titlebar` / `ui-user-terminal` pin `[data-terminal-pane]` keybinding fixtures and the Ctrl+` drawer toggle from Ghostty focus; `ui-surfaces` pins the `dshd-git-init` Diff-gate re-probe and the byte-based draft cap; `src/main/pty.test.js` pins reload/crash PTY reaping; `src/main/workspace-fs.test.js` pins one `git check-ignore --stdin -z` spawn per directory; `src/main/preview-workspace.test.js` pins streaming with `Content-Length` and the 413 size caps; `src/main/preview.test.js` pins the 512 MiB recording cap and the absence of the deleted `preview-automation-*` channels.
